description: Use when a trip includes a boat: Ha Long Bay cruises, Cat Ba, Cu Lao Cham (Hoi An), Ly Son, Con Dao or Phu Quoc. Returns official or operator notices that suspended sailing, with issuing authority, start and end time and source. With active_on it answers suspension_recorded or no_record for that day (never 'open'); without it, it returns the history so you can judge seasonal risk.

route.description: ha_long, cat_ba, cu_lao_cham, ly_son, con_dao, phu_quoc, or a place name
